clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau reads a study on the subtle signs that show you're actually intelligent - test yourself as you go.

Sign one: are you confident saying 'I don't know'? If someone asks you to help build a barn and you've never built one, the smart answer is 'I don't know how, but I'll help.' Not a bluff.

Sign two: do you solve problems from the right angle, not just the obvious one?

Sign three: can you hold two opposing ideas in your head at once? Kevin Trudeau says people who can do that are seen as more interesting, more likable - and that is worth real money.

Which one of the three did you fail?
